# Website Quality Audit: Nilov Catering Landing Page  

## Overall Layout & Structure  
The page uses a **dark-themed, single-column layout** with a clean, professional structure. Key sections include:  
- A top navigation bar (logo + menu)  
- A hero section with a tagline  
- A three-column feature grid (service highlights)  
- A pricing section (“Тарифы кофе-брейк”) with three tiered packages  

The layout is **responsive-friendly** (no obvious overflow or misalignment on standard screens) and prioritizes readability with ample white space between sections.  


## Color Scheme  
- **Primary Background**: Black (#000000) – creates a sleek, premium feel.  
- **Text Colors**:  
  - White (#FFFFFF) for most body copy (high contrast against black).  
  - Gold (#D4AF37) for accents (logo, headings, pricing, and the “ПОПУЛЯРНЫЙ” badge) – adds luxury and draws attention.  
- **Accent Colors**:  
  - Yellow (#FFD700) for the lightning bolt icon (first feature).  
  - Light gray (#E0E0E0) for the microphone icon (second feature).  
  - Orange (#FFA500) for the croissant icon (third feature).  
- **Button/Highlight**: Gold (#D4AF37) for the “ПОПУЛЯРНЫЙ” badge (subtle, non-intrusive).  


## Typography  
- **Logo**: “NILOV” (bold, serif font) + “CATERIN” (smaller, sans-serif) – distinct brand identity.  
- **Headings**:  
  - Main heading (“Тарифы кофе-брейк”): Large, elegant serif font (white + gold gradient) – emphasizes the section.  
  - Feature headings (“Быстрая организация,” etc.): Medium-sized, bold sans-serif (white) – clear and scannable.  
- **Body Copy**: Small-to-medium sans-serif (white) – easy to read against black.  
- **Pricing Text**:  
  - Tier names (“Стандарт,” “Бизнес,” “Премиум”): Medium sans-serif (white).  
  - Prices (“ОТ 800Р,” etc.): Large, bold gold font – stands out as a key value.  
  - “/ чел” (per person): Small gray font – secondary info.  
- **Navigation**: Sans-serif (white) – clean and consistent.  


## Spacing & Hierarchy  
- **Section Spacing**: Generous vertical padding between the hero, feature grid, and pricing sections (prevents clutter).  
- **Feature Grid**: Equal spacing between the three columns (consistent, balanced layout).  
- **Typography Hierarchy**: Clear contrast between headings (larger, bolder) and body copy (smaller, lighter) – guides the eye naturally.  
- **Padding/Margins**: Adequate internal padding in feature cards and pricing tiers (prevents text from touching edges).  


## Images & Icons  
- **Icons**:  
  - Lightning bolt (yellow) – represents speed.  
  - Microphone (light gray) – represents conferences.  
  - Croissant (orange) – represents food.  
  - All icons are simple, flat, and aligned consistently within their cards.  
- **Logo**: “NILOV” with a stylized “U” – professional and memorable.  
- **No large images** – the design relies on icons and text, keeping the focus on information.  


## Visual Issues (None Detected)  
- **Contrast**: All text (white on black) meets WCAG standards (high contrast, easy to read).  
- **Alignment**: Elements (logo, menu, feature cards, pricing tiers) are perfectly aligned (no skewed or mispositioned items).  
- **Consistency**: Color, font, and spacing are uniform across sections (no jarring inconsistencies).  
- **Clarity**: No overlapping text or hidden elements (all content is visible and accessible).  


## Additional Notes  
- A **WhatsApp icon** (green circle, bottom-right) is present for contact – functional and visually distinct.  
- The “ПОПУЛЯРНЫЙ” badge (gold) effectively highlights the “Бизнес” tier as the recommended option.  
- The overall design balances luxury (gold accents, dark theme) with clarity (clean layout, readable text) – ideal for a catering service targeting corporate clients.  


**Verdict**: The page is well-designed, visually consistent, and optimized for user experience. No critical issues detected.
